hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';const n=' Use 1./2./3. for numbered lists, never #1/#2/#3.';const m=/\bgit\s+(commit|push)\b|\bgh\s+pr\s+(create|edit)\b/.test(cmd)?'Load the gitwise:commit-pr-writing and gitwise:github-conventions skills.'+n:/\bgh\s+(pr|issue)\s+(create|comment|edit)|\bgh\s+pr\s+review\b|\bgit\s+tag\b/.test(cmd)?'Load the gitwise:github-conventions skill.'+n:'';if(m){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',additionalContext:m}}));}else if(i&&typeof i==='object'&&!Array.isArray(i)){console.log(d)}}catch{}})"

PreToolUse.description: Load commit-pr-writing and github-conventions before git commit/push and gh pr create/edit, github-conventions alone before gh issue create/comment/edit, gh pr comment/review and git tag
